reason: A proposes a genuinely prospective, single post-synthesis intervention with a plausible exhaust-relevant redox/sintering mechanism and a direct treated-versus-untreated aging test, although it critically depends on cerium already being present and avoiding site-blocking oxidation. B largely reproduces the cited fuel-cell ORR synthesis and mechanism, uses a two-step treatment, and extrapolates electrochemical corrosion/overpotential benefits to thermally aged gasoline exhaust without establishing nitrogen stability in oxidizing H2O/NO conditions.
